items.title: Mahalia Jackson Interview, 1955-07-26
items.q: We started to sing an old song about Daniel saw the stone.

ctx.x: Which were your first songs? The ones that really made you famous?

The ones that I came up from New Orleans with. We started to sing an old song about Daniel saw the stone. Now you might hear a choir singing, and they'll sing it so it's with a lot of opera tones to it, you know. But I didn't. I'd sing it, just went on. Oh, Daniel saw the stone that was you'd up to mountain, you'd up to mountain, you'd up to mountain, you'd up to mountain. Daniel saw the stone that was you'd up to mountain, came down to redeem a mighty world. And then it was simple, and the people could catch on.…

Now I'll tell you one thing. The first time I came in to see you, and we started talking, I felt sort of like a dead fish together with you. It was full of life and vitality. But you know, something happened to me while we were talking. Something, this seems to be contagious, you see, this kind of life.
